tracks.title: 阿嫲話唔使帶遮
tracks.genre: Cantonese 1960s girl-group pop (Brill Building style: tambourine, jangly guitar, upright bass, handclaps, strings)
tracks.subject: A TV weather presenter whose grandmother phones the studio during the 6:55 forecast to overrule him by what she reads from the clouds above her washing line.
